boundaryPolicy: Lower-inclusive; upper-exclusive except final band includes 1
invalidPolicy: Reject nonfinite, nonnumeric or out-of-range values; no clipping, default or fabricated contribution.
interpretation: Categorical accounting assertion tokens. These bands are not probability, monetary amount, severity, confidence or accounting materiality thresholds.
transport: Unpacked float64 JSON; fractional tokens must not be sent through integer-only packed cell encoding.
